mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logistics_import (customer_id, job_id, billing_month, trip_date, route, trip_count, fee_amount, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{jobId}, #{billingMonth}, #{tripDate}, #{route}, #{tripCount}, #{feeAmount}, #{notes}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM logistics_import WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY trip_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM logistics_import WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY trip_date ASC
